title: Climb Adds Netwrix to its Security Portfolio, Bringing Data and Indentity to VARs and MSPs
summary: Eatontown, NJ (October 14, 2026) – Climb, an international specialty technology distributor and wholly owned subsidiary of Climb Global Solutions,...
body_markdown:
**Eatontown, NJ (October 14, 2026)** –[Climb](https://www.climbcs.com/) , an international specialty technology distributor and wholly owned subsidiary of Climb Global Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: CLMB), today announced a distribution agreement with[Netwrix](https://netwrix.com/en/) , a global data and identity security company trusted by more than 13,000 organizations. The agreement gives Climb’s VARs and MSPs access to Netwrix solutions, including the 1Secure™ platform, so they can help customers protect sensitive data and control who can access it across hybrid and AI-driven environments.


Security is one of Climb’s core focus areas, and organizations are under growing pressure to protect sensitive data and control access to it as they bring AI into hybrid environments. Adding Netwrix’s data and identity security solutions helps Climb’s partners innovate faster, build new revenue streams, and champion best-of-breed solutions for their customers.


Netwrix helps organizations see exactly who and what can access their sensitive data and manage that access before it becomes a liability. Through the agreement, Climb’s network of VARs and MSPs in North America can now source and resell Netwrix solutions, backed by the quoting, financing and channel support Climb is known for, making it easier for customers to evaluate, purchase and deploy Netwrix’s solutions. Netwrix is seeing more customers ask where their sensitive data lives and who can access it, especially as AI tools and agents are granted access to more of it. This partnership gives Netwrix a broader path to reach those customers through partners who deliver solutions built to scale.


**“Every customer we can’t reach directly is a customer whose data and identities stay exposed a little longer. Climb’s network of VARs and MSPs gives us a fast, proven way to get Netwrix in front of more of those organizations, which is exactly what our mission calls for,” said Britt Norwood, CRO at Netwrix. “Climb has built a reputation for making it easy for partners to bring new technology to their customers, and we’re excited to be part of that community.”**


**“Security has always been core to our line card, and Netwrix strengthens that with a focus our partners are asking for: knowing where sensitive data lives and controlling who can get to it. It’s a natural fit alongside the rest of our security portfolio, and it gives our partners another way to help their customers move forward with AI and hybrid environments without losing control of their data,” said Dale Foster, CEO at Climb. “Netwrix has a strong reputation in the market, and we’re glad to welcome them to Climb.”**
